spec.title: Asteroid Collision
taskFacts: Integers list asteroids from left to right; magnitude gives size and sign gives travel direction. All move at the same speed.

When opposing asteroids meet, the smaller disappears; equal sizes both disappear. Asteroids traveling together do not meet. Return survivors in their original left-to-right order after every possible collision.

examples.explanation: The right-moving six destroys the approaching two; the final three travels right.
